title: GPT reflection (howto)
desc: How a GPT-family session records a recurrence-prevention reflection.
steps: RECORD EACH INCIDENT AS FOUR FACTS: symptom, root-cause CLASS, fix, and PROOF. Prefer a concrete machine check (the exact command/file/hook setting that proves the fix) over apology text.
LAYER-SEPARATE before naming a Codex/CLI hook bug: config feature flag -> hook command -> adapter stdout JSON -> exit code -> downstream harness decision; name the layer, not just the symptom.
DELEGATION FAILURES: verify the REAL model family that answered (modelUsage), not only the dispatcher exit code -- a silent fallback to haiku looks like success.
PROMOTE only durable recurrence-prevention knowledge; leave transient logs, cache state, one-off screenshots out.
TRIGGER: a GPT session hits a reusable startup/hook/identity/delegation/transport/encoding/guard failure that can recur in future GPT sessions.

DISPATCH PROOF CONTRACT: before re-dispatching a cheap worker after a failed or ambiguous probe, require changed files plus exact PASS/FAIL lines plus nonzero exit on missing cases. Exit code 0 without visible PASS output is not structural proof and should be recorded as a debrief before any next Agent.cmd dispatch.

CODEX HARNESS REPAIR ORDER: when Agent.cmd is blocked by agent-debrief and ROOT verification is blocked by busy-fleet, do not retry the same dispatch. Sequence: (1) read gpt-reflection/gpt-mini-reflection plus the specific guard skill, (2) record the circular blocker with wkappbot skill edit if needed, (3) delegate a bounded cheap worker only for proto/probe plus its own self-test, (4) if Codex built-in delegation completion is not credited, fix/verify busy-fleet Get-WkLastDelegationTs first, (5) run git diff --check and the worker self-test, (6) wire debrief/session fallback only after proof, (7) run a live Agent.cmd --model gpt-5-mini canary. Proof command examples: git diff --check -- tools/wkharness-guards-busyfleet.ps1 tools/wkharness-guards-agent-debrief.ps1; & .\tools\wkharness-codex-agent-debrief-session-fallback-probe-selftest.ps1.

2026-07-28 INCIDENT: GPT/Codex ROOT misfiled delegation and skill-edit lessons into gpt-mini-reflection/codex-reflection instead of the model-name reflection returned by wkagent-name. Reflex: run or trust wkagent-name for the active model reflection target; write this agent's recurring hook/delegation/skill-edit lessons to gpt-reflection, and use sibling reflection skills only when explicitly reviewing that sibling's own failure.

Stop-hook repair evidence: when a dot-sourced module calls an optional helper such as _wkPerf before the caller defines it, add a guarded file-scope fallback in the module, then verify with Parser.ParseFile and the canonical self-test; a command-not-found exception is a hook defect, not a clean-turn verdict.

2026-06-14 incident: GPT-family delegation and Codex hook repair were delayed by identity confusion between mini, GPT, and Haiku reflection requirements. Fix: keep gpt-reflection and gpt-mini-reflection separate, verify the active family before satisfying on-load, and treat mismatched reflection prompts as an identity-scoping bug.
2026-06-25: wkharness-agent-name now trusts CODEX_THREAD_ID session JSONL before parent Claude lineage, so git-hook model detection preserves live Codex GPT sessions instead of collapsing to sonnet.

INCIDENT: 2026-06-25 Codex wkpace work exposed three GPT-family recurrence risks: do not trust latest session file without cwd match, do not dot-source standalone scripts that print raw model ids, and do not patch installed runtime files with unescaped PowerShell replacement strings. Fix path: join CODEX_THREAD_ID session JSONL only when turn_context.cwd equals the live process cwd, keep standalone helpers invoked not dot-sourced, and use parse/test after every installed-file bridge edit.

2026-06-30 PERSONAL-DOCS STARTUP FAILURE. Symptom: the user sent the exact gg shortcut and GPT asked what task to run. Root cause: AGENTS.md was loaded but treated as passive prose; GPT did not follow its CLAUDE.md pointer or activate the repository gg workflow. Fix: when AGENTS.md delegates shared policy to CLAUDE.md, read CLAUDE.md before interpreting bare shortcuts; exact gg/ggg or repeated Korean giyeok starts the documented workflow immediately. Proof: read AGENTS.md, locate the pointer, read CLAUDE.md, and execute its gg Main Workflow from step zero.

TODO: Audit Codex pace integration end-to-end: verify wkpace-codex.ps1 display against Get-WkCodexPaceInfo object fields for 5h/weekly used/remaining/limit/target, and verify whether Codex over-pace/weekly pressure is actually wired to root action restrictions in the harness. Measurement should be delegated read-only; root performs inference and any wiring changes.

INCIDENT 2026-10-13: Codex file-read transport mismatch reproduced. Symptom: wkappbot file read HANDOFF.md and Read.cmd JSON both printed all 21 lines, but every non-skill command still received predecessor handoff not read. Root-cause class: on-load observes Read-tool metadata rather than returned bytes. Fix: preserve the refusal, use only the sanctioned Read tool or owner reset, and do not claim the gate is cleared from file output alone. Proof: exact refusal remained on build.cmd and Agent.cmd after both read paths.
